options.name: ca_config
options.description: The path to the certificate authority configuration file on the host.

options.name: ca_url
options.description: URI of the targeted Step Certificate Authority. Used if the module is run in online mode (default) and the hosts C(step-cli) is not configured to trust the CA.

options.name: crt_file
options.description: The certificate in PEM format that we want to renew.

options.name: exec
options.description: The command to run after the certificate has been renewed.

options.name: expires_in
options.description: The amount of time remaining before certificate expiration, at which point a renewal should be attempted. The certificate renewal will not be performed if the time to expiration is greater than the I(expires_in) value. A random jitter (duration/20) will be added to avoid multiple services hitting the renew endpoint at the same time. The duration is a sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (o

options.name: force
options.description: Force the overwrite of files without asking.

options.name: key_file
options.description: They key file of the certificate.

options.name: offline
options.description: Don't contact the CA. Offline mode uses the configuration, certificates, and keys created with step ca init, but can accept a different configuration file using the I(ca_config) flag.

options.name: output_file
options.description: The new certificate file path. Defaults to overwriting the crt-file positional argument.

options.name: password_file
options.description: The path to the file containing the password to encrypt or decrypt the private key.

options.name: pid
options.description: The process id to signal after the certificate has been renewed. By default the the SIGHUP (1) signal will be used, but this can be configured with the I(signal) parameter.

options.name: pid_file
options.description: The path from which to read the process id that will be signaled after the certificate has been renewed. By default the the SIGHUP (1) signal will be used, but this can be configured with the I(signal) parameter.

options.name: root
options.description: The path to the PEM file used as the root certificate authority. Used if the module is run in online mode (default) and the hosts C(step-cli) is not configured to trust the CA.

options.name: signal
options.description: The signal number to send to the selected PID, so it can reload the configuration and load the new certificate. Default value is SIGHUP (1).

options.name: step_cli_executable
options.description: Name (or absolute path) of the C(step-cli) executable to use
